meta.alignment: t=0 is t_phys (physical wheel stop, max positive unload edge in 0.15s-smoothed raw fwd accel)

channels.v_ego: Kalman vEgo (lags ~0.33s near stop, floors near 0)
channels.pitch_rate: gyroUncalibrated.v[1] - per-stop parked bias, 0.1s smoothed; noise sigma 0.0026
channels.v_recon: integral of decel_true back from v=0 at t_phys; honest 100Hz terminal velocity

per_stop_params.excluded_reason: brake-free creep dip, final park 3s later

recipe.anchor: all times relative to t_phys (physical wheel stop); v_ap = max vEgo in last 6 s (m/s); decel positive m/s^2

phase2_release.note: half the stops release essentially fully (frac <=0.03, some briefly accelerate on creep)

phase4_touch.rebuild_onset_v: 0.5-1.5 m/s on dwell stops; last 0.3-0.4 s on taper stops
phase4_touch.prescription: A_touch <= 0.4; bob_peak ~= 0.0047 + 0.0138*carry (r=0.63); predicts BOTH auto stops within 0.001 (0.0114 vs 0.0119 actual, 0.0169 vs 0.0179)

phase5_after_stop.hold_build: not observable in these logs (no brake pressure channel); brakePressed stays latched

worst_manual.caveat: parked sigma 0.0045 (idle vibration) + grade drift; bob overstated but carry real

worst_manual.note: clean measurement; hard 7.4 m/s approach, peak 2.68, landed at 0.76

exemplars.discriminator: carry/terminal decel at the wheel-stop instant (bob r=0.63); NOT approach speed (r=0.23), NOT peak decel (r=0.41), NOT shape class (both classes bob median 0.011-0.012)
caveats: 00001f4a--4 carry 0.82 over-reads ~+0.3 (v_recon vs Kalman check 0.71; Kalman terminal 0.45; brief-stop baseline)
